title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium on 1982-12-26
source: SDB>>MR>>PCM>>DAT>>CDR there may be a cassette gen somewhere in the  lineage, but i am not positive.

ai_review.summary: Decent soundboard capture of a historically significant show featuring Phil Lesh’s first 6‑string bass and the tight ’82 band sound.
ai_review.review: The recording is a decent soundboard (sbd) that clearly presents the tight, high‑energy playing typical of the Dead in 1982. Reviewers highlight the historical moment of Phil Lesh debuting an Alembic 6‑string bass, adding extra interest to an otherwise solid performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Single positive review (4 stars) notes decent recording quality and a tight, energetic show; limited data results in low confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Decent soundboard recording; clear enough to capture the tight 1982 band sound with no major issues mentioned.

band_member_comments.Phil: First show using an Alembic 6‑string bass, noted as a historic moment.
